target.rawSql: SELECT window_end AS time, pair || ' anomaly z=' || z_score AS text, pair AS tags FROM fx_anomalies WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end)

panels.title: FX Rate (raw vs. 5m rolling avg, computed in TimescaleDB)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, pair || ' raw' AS metric, rate::float8 AS value FROM fx_rates WHERE $__timeFilter(time) UNION ALL SELECT time, pair || ' 5m avg' AS metric, avg(rate::float8) OVER (PARTITION BY pair ORDER BY time RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '5 minutes' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS value FROM fx_rates WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM fx_anomalies WHERE time > now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT time, pair, rate::float8 AS rate, z_score::float8 AS z_score, window_start, window_end FROM fx_anomalies WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT time, series_id AS metric, value::float8 AS value FROM macro_history WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
